note: Copy to configs/arms.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Serial from: ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/. base_pose_m: base origin in the table frame (m). base_yaw_deg: mounting yaw, the arm's forward direction at shoulder_pan = 0. reach: "so101" (0.44 m fully extended, hip +-110 deg), "*" (everything), or {"preset": "so101", "r_max": ...} to override.
